daily.today_energy: Venus is in your sign today, which is basically your personal glow-up happening in real time. You're magnetic and naturally charismatic right now, so lean into that energy. The Mars-Jupiter conjunction is loud and competitive though, so channel that confidence without overdoing it.
daily.love: With Venus lighting up your chart, people are genuinely drawn to you today. If you're single, someone might make a move. If you're coupled up, your partner's probably feeling the warmth. Just remember the Mars-Jupiter hype can make things feel bigger than they are—keep it real.
daily.career: This is actually solid for getting things done. Mars and Jupiter together give you ambition and luck, even though the Sun's tension with both planets means some egos might clash. Stand firm in your ideas but listen too. Your diplomatic nature is your secret weapon today.
daily.health: You've got good energy to work with, but Saturn retrograde in Aries is asking you to slow down with self-care. Don't burn out trying to do everything. A solid workout or walk would hit different today—something grounding that lets you process all this intensity.

weekly.overview: Venus in your sign is throwing major charm this week, especially as it sextiles Jupiter early on—you're magnetic and people feel it. Watch the Sun-Mars square midweek; it'll test your patience with slow-moving situations. Best Day: Tuesday. Watch-Out Day: Wednesday. By Friday, the Full Moon in Gemini lights up communication; speak your truth before the weekend arrives.
weekly.love: Early week is your golden window for romance or deepening connections thanks to Venus sextile Jupiter. If you've been hesitant about making a move, Tuesday's your moment. Midweek tension might make conversations feel prickly, but that's actually clearing dead weight. By the weekend, vulnerability becomes your superpower.
weekly.career: The Sun-Mars square hits your sector of public moves and visibility—frustration is real, but don't react impulsively. This is about recalibrating strategy, not forcing things. Mid-to-late week, Mercury in Scorpio helps you dig into details others miss. Use that edge. Friday's Full Moon brings clarity on a project or partnership direction.
weekly.health: Energy dips midweek due to planetary friction; honor that by scaling back if possible. Moon trine Mars gives you a physical edge early week—great for movement or starting something new. By weekend, the Full Moon might stir up emotions; journaling or talking it out matters more than pushing through.
